from collections import defaultdict, Counter
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from sqlalchemy import func
from app.models import db, ViewingHistory, Product, CartItem

class RecommendationEngine:
    
    @staticmethod
    def get_recommendations(user_id=None, session_id=None, limit=10):
        """
        Generate product recommendations based on viewing history
        Uses collaborative filtering and category-based recommendations
        """
        recommendations = []
        
        # Get user's viewing history
        viewed_products = RecommendationEngine._get_viewing_history(user_id, session_id)
        
        if not viewed_products:
            # Return popular products if no history
            return RecommendationEngine._get_popular_products(limit)
        
        # Get recommendations based on viewed products
        category_based = RecommendationEngine._get_category_based_recommendations(
            viewed_products, limit
        )
        
        collaborative = RecommendationEngine._get_collaborative_recommendations(
            viewed_products, user_id, session_id, limit
        )
        
        # Combine recommendations (remove duplicates, prioritize collaborative)
        seen_ids = set(viewed_products)
        
        for product in collaborative:
            if product.id not in seen_ids:
                recommendations.append(product)
                seen_ids.add(product.id)
        
        for product in category_based:
            if product.id not in seen_ids and len(recommendations) < limit:
                recommendations.append(product)
                seen_ids.add(product.id)
        
        # Fill with popular products if needed
        if len(recommendations) < limit:
            popular = RecommendationEngine._get_popular_products(limit)
            for product in popular:
                if product.id not in seen_ids and len(recommendations) < limit:
                    recommendations.append(product)
                    seen_ids.add(product.id)
        
        return recommendations[:limit]
    
    @staticmethod
    def _get_viewing_history(user_id, session_id, days=30):
        """Get products viewed by user/session in last N days"""
        cutoff_date = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=days)
        
        query = db.session.query(ViewingHistory.product_id).filter(
            ViewingHistory.viewed_at >= cutoff_date
        )
        
        if user_id:
            query = query.filter(ViewingHistory.user_id == user_id)
        elif session_id:
            query = query.filter(ViewingHistory.session_id == session_id)
        else:
            return []
        
        return [row[0] for row in query.distinct().all()]
    
    @staticmethod
    def _get_category_based_recommendations(viewed_product_ids, limit):
        """Recommend products from same categories as viewed products"""
        if not viewed_product_ids:
            return []
        
        # Get categories of viewed products
        categories = db.session.query(Product.category_id).filter(
            Product.id.in_(viewed_product_ids)
        ).distinct().all()
        
        category_ids = [cat[0] for cat in categories if cat[0]]
        
        if not category_ids:
            return []
        
        # Get highly rated products from these categories
        products = Product.query.filter(
            Product.category_id.in_(category_ids),
            Product.id.notin_(viewed_product_ids)
        ).order_by(
            Product.rating.desc(),
            Product.review_count.desc()
        ).limit(limit).all()
        
        return products
    
    @staticmethod
    def _get_collaborative_recommendations(viewed_product_ids, user_id, session_id, limit):
        """
        Collaborative filtering: Find users who viewed similar products,
        and recommend what they also viewed
        """
        if not viewed_product_ids:
            return []
        
        # Find other users/sessions who viewed the same products
        similar_viewers = db.session.query(
            ViewingHistory.user_id,
            ViewingHistory.session_id,
            func.count(ViewingHistory.product_id).label('common_views')
        ).filter(
            ViewingHistory.product_id.in_(viewed_product_ids)
        ).group_by(
            ViewingHistory.user_id,
            ViewingHistory.session_id
        ).having(
            func.count(ViewingHistory.product_id) >= min(2, len(viewed_product_ids))
        )
        
        # Exclude current user/session
        if user_id:
            similar_viewers = similar_viewers.filter(ViewingHistory.user_id != user_id)
        if session_id:
            similar_viewers = similar_viewers.filter(ViewingHistory.session_id != session_id)
        
        similar_viewers = similar_viewers.limit(50).all()
        
        if not similar_viewers:
            return []
        
        # Get products viewed by similar users
        similar_user_ids = [v.user_id for v in similar_viewers if v.user_id]
        similar_session_ids = [v.session_id for v in similar_viewers if v.session_id]
        
        recommended_product_ids = db.session.query(
            ViewingHistory.product_id,
            func.count(ViewingHistory.product_id).label('view_count')
        ).filter(
            db.or_(
                ViewingHistory.user_id.in_(similar_user_ids) if similar_user_ids else False,
                ViewingHistory.session_id.in_(similar_session_ids) if similar_session_ids else False
            ),
            ViewingHistory.product_id.notin_(viewed_product_ids)
        ).group_by(
            ViewingHistory.product_id
        ).order_by(
            func.count(ViewingHistory.product_id).desc()
        ).limit(limit).all()
        
        product_ids = [p[0] for p in recommended_product_ids]
        
        if not product_ids:
            return []
        
        # Fetch actual products maintaining order
        products = Product.query.filter(Product.id.in_(product_ids)).all()
        product_dict = {p.id: p for p in products}
        
        return [product_dict[pid] for pid in product_ids if pid in product_dict]
    
    @staticmethod
    def _get_popular_products(limit):
        """Get popular products based on rating and review count"""
        return Product.query.order_by(
            Product.rating.desc(),
            Product.review_count.desc()
        ).limit(limit).all()

    """Get or create session ID from headers"""
    return request.headers.get('X-Session-ID', str(uuid.uuid4()))

def token_required(f):
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated(*args, **kwargs):
        token = request.headers.get('Authorization')
        
        if not token:
            return jsonify({'error': 'Token is missing'}), 401
        
        try:
            if token.startswith('Bearer '):
                token = token[7:]
            data = jwt.decode(token, Config.SECRET_KEY, algorithms=['HS256'])
            current_user = User.query.get(data['user_id'])
            if not current_user:
                return jsonify({'error': 'User not found'}), 401
        except Exception as e:
            return jsonify({'error': 'Token is invalid'}), 401
        
        return f(current_user, *args, **kwargs)
    
    return decorated

def admin_required(f):
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated(*args, **kwargs):
        token = request.headers.get('Authorization')
        
        if not token:
            return jsonify({'error': 'Token is missing'}), 401
        
        try:
            if token.startswith('Bearer '):
                token = token[7:]

            current_user = User.query.get(data['user_id'])
            if not current_user or not current_user.is_admin:

        except Exception as e:
            return jsonify({'error': 'Token is invalid'}), 401
        
        return f(current_user, *args, **kwargs)

    sort_order = request.args.get('sort_order', 'desc')
    
    query = Product.query
    
    # Apply filters
    if category_id:
        query = query.filter(Product.category_id == category_id)
    
    if min_price is not None:
        query = query.filter(Product.price >= min_price)
    
    if max_price is not None:
        query = query.filter(Product.price <= max_price)
    
    if min_rating is not None:
        query = query.filter(Product.rating >= min_rating)
    
    if search:
        search_term = f'%{search}%'
        query = query.filter(
            or_(
                Product.name.ilike(search_term),
                Product.description.ilike(search_term)
            )
        )
    
    # Apply sorting
    if sort_by == 'price':
        order_col = Product.price
    elif sort_by == 'rating':
        order_col = Product.rating
    elif sort_by == 'name':
        order_col = Product.name
    else:
        order_col = Product.created_at
    
    if sort_order == 'asc':
        query = query.order_by(order_col.asc())
    else:
        query = query.order_by(order_col.desc())
    
    # Paginate
    pagination = query.paginate(page=page, per_page=per_page, error_out=False)
    
    return jsonify({
        'products': [p.to_dict(include_inventory=True) for p in pagination.items],
        'total': pagination.total,
        'pages': pagination.pages,
        'current_page': page,
        'per_page': per_page
    })

    else:

      loadReviews(Number(id));

      alert('Failed to load cart');

    }

    try {
      if (quantity <= 0) {
        await cartAPI.remove(itemId);
      } else {
        await cartAPI.update(itemId, quantity);
      }
      loadCart();
      onCartUpdate();
    } catch (error: any) {
      alert(error.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to update cart');

  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<Category[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'products' | 'categories'>('products');
  const [editingProduct, setEditingProduct] = useState<Partial<Product> | null>(null);
  const [editingCategory, setEditingCategory] = useState<Partial<Category> | null>(null);
  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState<File | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [productsRes, categoriesRes] = await Promise.all([
        productAPI.getAll({ per_page: 100 }),
        categoryAPI.getAll(),
      ]);
      setProducts(productsRes.data.products);
      setCategories(categoriesRes.data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load data:', error);
      alert('Failed to load data');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleProductSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editingProduct) return;

    try {
      let imageUrl = editingProduct.image_url;

      // Upload image if selected
      if (imageFile) {
        const uploadRes = await productAPI.uploadImage(imageFile);
        imageUrl = uploadRes.data.url;
      }

      const productData = { ...editingProduct, image_url: imageUrl };

      if (editingProduct.id) {
        await productAPI.update(editingProduct.id, productData);
      } else {
        await productAPI.create(productData);
      }

      setEditingProduct(null);
      setImageFile(null);
      loadData();
      alert('Product saved successfully!');

      alert(error.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to save product');

      alert('Failed to delete product');
